help.title: Help centre
help.subtitle: Quick answers about payments, fees and your account.
help.pinNotice: TripPay will never ask for your PIN or a one-time code outside the app's dedicated code screen. Report anyone who does.

pending.q: My payment says pending. Did it fail?
pending.a: No. Pending means we are waiting for the provider's confirmation. Don't pay again — we'll update the status and notify you.

fees.q: When do I see the fee?
fees.a: Always before you confirm. The review screen shows the amount, the fee and the total, and nothing is sent until you confirm.

refund.a: If a payment fails after money left your wallet, or a merchant refunds you, the amount returns to your wallet with its own reference.

verify.q: Why do I need to verify my account?
verify.a: Verification protects you and the businesses you pay. Some limits only lift after your identity is confirmed.

pin.q: Will TripPay ever ask for my mobile-money PIN?
pin.a: Never. You authorise mobile-money payments on your provider's own prompt. TripPay staff will never ask for PINs or codes.

contact.q: How do I reach a human?
contact.a: Open Support in the app and create a case. You'll get a case reference and updates in your notifications.

service.title: What TripPay is
service.body: TripPay is a product concept for travel payments and money management. It is not a bank, lender, currency dealer or crypto exchange. Regulated services depend on licensed partners and approvals.

fees.title: Fees
fees.body: Any fee is shown on the review screen before you confirm a payment, and again on the receipt. Fees come from the payment quote, never a surprise.

data.title: Your data
data.body: We collect only what the service needs, explain why, and limit who can see it. Admin staff see masked personal data by default and every sensitive action is audit-logged.

gated.title: Features marked "coming soon"
gated.body: Travel financing, currency exchange execution, transfers between users and crypto features require separate legal and partner approval. They are shown for transparency but are not available.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions about this prototype or your data: open a support case in the app.

assistant.title: TripPay assistant
assistant.subtitle: Quick answers about how TripPay works.
assistant.welcome: Habari! Ask me about payments, fees, pending statuses or refunds. I can't see your balances or transactions — for anything account-specific, I'll point you to a human.
assistant.boundaryNote: The assistant never invents balances, payment results or rates. Account questions go to human support.

answers.pending: Pending means we're waiting for the provider to confirm. Don't pay again — the status updates automatically and you'll get a notification.
answers.fees: Every fee is shown on the review screen before you confirm, and again on the receipt. TripPay's standard fee in this prototype is 1% per payment.
answers.refunds: Refunds return to your wallet with their own reference. If a payment failed, nothing left your wallet.
answers.pin: TripPay never asks for your PIN or one-time codes — not in chat, not by phone. You only authorise payments on your provider's own prompt.
answers.fallback: I can help with how payments, fees, savings and statuses work. For your specific account or transaction, please open a support case — a human will pick it up with a case reference.
